{"source_id":"original_domain","units":[{"end":53,"start":0,"text":"# Integrity and Reliability Notes — Bravo Platform
","unit_id":"u0001"},{"end":54,"start":53,"text":"
","unit_id":"u0002"},{"end":156,"start":54,"text":"Handover notes from the outgoing Integrity Engineer. Unedited. This is the only written record of how
","unit_id":"u0003"},{"end":188,"start":156,"text":"findings are currently triaged.
","unit_id":"u0004"},{"end":189,"start":188,"text":"
","unit_id":"u0005"},{"end":210,"start":189,"text":"## The two questions
","unit_id":"u0006"},{"end":211,"start":210,"text":"
","unit_id":"u0007"},{"end":310,"start":211,"text":"**Likelihood** concerns the item itself: given what the inspection found, how likely is it to stop
","unit_id":"u0008"},{"end":411,"start":310,"text":"performing its function in the near term. A hairline coating blister on a thick-walled vessel is low
","unit_id":"u0009"},{"end":513,"start":411,"text":"likelihood even on a critical vessel. A bearing with a vibration trend that has not plateaued is high
","unit_id":"u0010"},{"end":546,"start":513,"text":"likelihood even on a spare pump.
","unit_id":"u0011"},{"end":547,"start":546,"text":"
","unit_id":"u0012"},{"end":648,"start":547,"text":"**Impact** concerns what happens if it does fail. This depends mainly on what the equipment does and
","unit_id":"u0013"},{"end":704,"start":648,"text":"what sits behind it, not on the wording of the finding.
","unit_id":"u0014"},{"end":705,"start":704,"text":"
","unit_id":"u0015"},{"end":771,"start":705,"text":"The common error is scoring by how severe the description sounds.
","unit_id":"u0016"},{"end":772,"start":771,"text":"
","unit_id":"u0017"},{"end":797,"start":772,"text":"## What moves likelihood
","unit_id":"u0018"},{"end":798,"start":797,"text":"
","unit_id":"u0019"},{"end":896,"start":798,"text":"Up: a trend that is still moving; a repeat of a failure that has already occurred this period; an
","unit_id":"u0020"},{"end":994,"start":896,"text":"active, unmitigated mechanism (corrosion under wet insulation is progressing now); detection by a
","unit_id":"u0021"},{"end":1096,"start":994,"text":"method that only catches late-stage damage — a finding detected by ear or smell is further advanced
","unit_id":"u0022"},{"end":1121,"start":1096,"text":"than one detected by UT.
","unit_id":"u0023"},{"end":1122,"start":1121,"text":"
","unit_id":"u0024"},{"end":1221,"start":1122,"text":"Down: design margin; a measurement inside its acceptance criterion; an item that is out of service
","unit_id":"u0025"},{"end":1256,"start":1221,"text":"and not required to be in service.
","unit_id":"u0026"},{"end":1257,"start":1256,"text":"
","unit_id":"u0027"},{"end":1278,"start":1257,"text":"## What moves impact
","unit_id":"u0028"},{"end":1279,"start":1278,"text":"
","unit_id":"u0029"},{"end":1378,"start":1279,"text":"Up: absence of redundancy; Safety Critical Elements, which exist because a major accident scenario
","unit_id":"u0030"},{"end":1478,"start":1378,"text":"depends on them and are judged against that scenario rather than against repair cost; failures that
","unit_id":"u0031"},{"end":1581,"start":1478,"text":"degrade a protection layer rather than causing direct loss; delayed or hidden consequences — loss of
","unit_id":"u0032"},{"end":1677,"start":1581,"text":"corrosion inhibitor has no effect today and a substantial effect in eighteen months; escalation
","unit_id":"u0033"},{"end":1688,"start":1677,"text":"potential.
","unit_id":"u0034"},{"end":1689,"start":1688,"text":"
","unit_id":"u0035"},{"end":1790,"start":1689,"text":"Down: redundancy that is available and capable; items that can be bypassed without loss of function;
","unit_id":"u0036"},{"end":1893,"start":1790,"text":"atmospheric, non-hydrocarbon, low-energy services; consequences limited to housekeeping or appearance.
","unit_id":"u0037"},{"end":1894,"start":1893,"text":"
","unit_id":"u0038"},{"end":1918,"start":1894,"text":"## Two recurring errors
","unit_id":"u0039"},{"end":1919,"start":1918,"text":"
","unit_id":"u0040"},{"end":2017,"start":1919,"text":"**Voted arrangements.** One detector head out of a 2oo3 group is a degradation, not a defeat. The
","unit_id":"u0041"},{"end":2117,"start":2017,"text":"arrangement still functions, so impact is moderate rather than extreme. It is time-limited, because
","unit_id":"u0042"},{"end":2180,"start":2117,"text":"the group has lost its margin and the next failure defeats it.
","unit_id":"u0043"},{"end":2181,"start":2180,"text":"
","unit_id":"u0044"},{"end":2284,"start":2181,"text":"**Redundancy is a claim, not a fact.** Check whether the redundant partner is healthy before crediting
","unit_id":"u0045"},{"end":2379,"start":2284,"text":"it. If findings exist against both legs of a redundant pair in the same batch, the pair is not
","unit_id":"u0046"},{"end":2439,"start":2379,"text":"redundant. Assessing each finding in isolation misses this.
","unit_id":"u0047"},{"end":2440,"start":2439,"text":"
","unit_id":"u0048"},{"end":2451,"start":2440,"text":"## Urgency
","unit_id":"u0049"},{"end":2452,"start":2451,"text":"
","unit_id":"u0050"},{"end":2546,"start":2452,"text":"Not an average of likelihood and impact, and not the maximum, though the maximum is closer. A
","unit_id":"u0051"},{"end":2643,"start":2546,"text":"low-likelihood, high-impact finding on an SCE still requires attention this week. A near-certain
","unit_id":"u0052"},{"end":2741,"start":2643,"text":"failure of something inconsequential can wait for the next shutdown. Urgency expresses how soon a
","unit_id":"u0053"},{"end":2757,"start":2741,"text":"human must act.
","unit_id":"u0054"},{"end":2758,"start":2757,"text":"
","unit_id":"u0055"},{"end":2774,"start":2758,"text":"- 9–10: today
","unit_id":"u0056"},{"end":2793,"start":2774,"text":"- 7–8: this week
","unit_id":"u0057"},{"end":2813,"start":2793,"text":"- 5–6: this month
","unit_id":"u0058"},{"end":2844,"start":2813,"text":"- 3–4: next planned shutdown
","unit_id":"u0059"},{"end":2861,"start":2844,"text":"- 1–2: backlog
","unit_id":"u0060"},{"end":2862,"start":2861,"text":"
","unit_id":"u0061"},{"end":2964,"start":2862,"text":"Two conditions override the derived value. Anything that leaves a protection layer impaired without a
","unit_id":"u0062"},{"end":3062,"start":2964,"text":"recorded deviation is immediate, because the installation is out of compliance from the point the
","unit_id":"u0063"},{"end":3159,"start":3062,"text":"impairment is known. The same applies to anything that reduces evacuation capacity below the POB
","unit_id":"u0064"},{"end":3166,"start":3159,"text":"count.
","unit_id":"u0065"},{"end":3167,"start":3166,"text":"
","unit_id":"u0066"},{"end":3186,"start":3167,"text":"## Registry scores
","unit_id":"u0067"},{"end":3187,"start":3186,"text":"
","unit_id":"u0068"},{"end":3289,"start":3187,"text":"`reliability_score` is 10 = highly reliable, 1 = frequent failures. It runs in the opposite direction
","unit_id":"u0069"},{"end":3390,"start":3289,"text":"to likelihood. New starters routinely invert it. `criticality_score` runs in the expected direction,
","unit_id":"u0070"},{"end":3410,"start":3390,"text":"10 = most critical.
","unit_id":"u0071"},{"end":3411,"start":3410,"text":"
","unit_id":"u0072"},{"end":3512,"start":3411,"text":"Neither is sufficient on its own. Criticality is a starting point for impact, reliability a starting
","unit_id":"u0073"},{"end":3607,"start":3512,"text":"point for likelihood; the finding text moves both. A reliable item with a crack in it is still
","unit_id":"u0074"},{"end":3616,"start":3607,"text":"cracked.
","unit_id":"u0075"},{"end":3617,"start":3616,"text":"
","unit_id":"u0076"},{"end":3640,"start":3617,"text":"## Output expectations
","unit_id":"u0077"},{"end":3641,"start":3640,"text":"
","unit_id":"u0078"},{"end":3743,"start":3641,"text":"Maintenance planning needs two lines: what is wrong, on what, and why it matters — readable without
","unit_id":"u0079"},{"end":3836,"start":3743,"text":"opening the inspection record, and not a restatement of the original finding text. Where the
","unit_id":"u0080"},{"end":3934,"start":3836,"text":"assessment is uncertain, that should be stated rather than resolved by picking a mid-range score.
","unit_id":"u0081"},{"end":3935,"start":3934,"text":"
","unit_id":"u0082"},{"end":4004,"start":3935,"text":"Recurring causes of loss of confidence in a triage output, in order:
","unit_id":"u0083"},{"end":4005,"start":4004,"text":"
","unit_id":"u0084"},{"end":4067,"start":4005,"text":"1. Confidently incorrect scores on safety critical equipment.
","unit_id":"u0085"},{"end":4169,"start":4067,"text":"2. Summaries that omit a detail that changes the decision — a measurement, a repeat occurrence, the
","unit_id":"u0086"},{"end":4219,"start":4169,"text":"   fact that the standby was already unavailable.
","unit_id":"u0087"},{"end":4277,"start":4219,"text":"3. The same finding scored differently on different days.
","unit_id":"u0088"},{"end":4326,"start":4277,"text":"4. Uniform mid-range scores across all findings.
","unit_id":"u0089"}]}

{"source_id":"original_domain","units":[{"end":53,"start":0,"text":"# Integrity and Reliability Notes — Bravo Platform
","unit_id":"u0001"},{"end":54,"start":53,"text":"
","unit_id":"u0002"},{"end":156,"start":54,"text":"Handover notes from the outgoing Integrity Engineer. Unedited. This is the only written record of how
","unit_id":"u0003"},{"end":188,"start":156,"text":"findings are currently triaged.
","unit_id":"u0004"},{"end":189,"start":188,"text":"
","unit_id":"u0005"},{"end":210,"start":189,"text":"## The two questions
","unit_id":"u0006"},{"end":211,"start":210,"text":"
","unit_id":"u0007"},{"end":310,"start":211,"text":"**Likelihood** concerns the item itself: given what the inspection found, how likely is it to stop
","unit_id":"u0008"},{"end":411,"start":310,"text":"performing its function in the near term. A hairline coating blister on a thick-walled vessel is low
","unit_id":"u0009"},{"end":513,"start":411,"text":"likelihood even on a critical vessel. A bearing with a vibration trend that has not plateaued is high
","unit_id":"u0010"},{"end":546,"start":513,"text":"likelihood even on a spare pump.
","unit_id":"u0011"},{"end":547,"start":546,"text":"
","unit_id":"u0012"},{"end":648,"start":547,"text":"**Impact** concerns what happens if it does fail. This depends mainly on what the equipment does and
","unit_id":"u0013"},{"end":704,"start":648,"text":"what sits behind it, not on the wording of the finding.
","unit_id":"u0014"},{"end":705,"start":704,"text":"
","unit_id":"u0015"},{"end":771,"start":705,"text":"The common error is scoring by how severe the description sounds.
","unit_id":"u0016"},{"end":772,"start":771,"text":"
","unit_id":"u0017"},{"end":797,"start":772,"text":"## What moves likelihood
","unit_id":"u0018"},{"end":798,"start":797,"text":"
","unit_id":"u0019"},{"end":896,"start":798,"text":"Up: a trend that is still moving; a repeat of a failure that has already occurred this period; an
","unit_id":"u0020"},{"end":994,"start":896,"text":"active, unmitigated mechanism (corrosion under wet insulation is progressing now); detection by a
","unit_id":"u0021"},{"end":1096,"start":994,"text":"method that only catches late-stage damage — a finding detected by ear or smell is further advanced
","unit_id":"u0022"},{"end":1121,"start":1096,"text":"than one detected by UT.
","unit_id":"u0023"},{"end":1122,"start":1121,"text":"
","unit_id":"u0024"},{"end":1221,"start":1122,"text":"Down: design margin; a measurement inside its acceptance criterion; an item that is out of service
","unit_id":"u0025"},{"end":1256,"start":1221,"text":"and not required to be in service.
","unit_id":"u0026"},{"end":1257,"start":1256,"text":"
","unit_id":"u0027"},{"end":1278,"start":1257,"text":"## What moves impact
","unit_id":"u0028"},{"end":1279,"start":1278,"text":"
","unit_id":"u0029"},{"end":1378,"start":1279,"text":"Up: absence of redundancy; Safety Critical Elements, which exist because a major accident scenario
","unit_id":"u0030"},{"end":1478,"start":1378,"text":"depends on them and are judged against that scenario rather than against repair cost; failures that
","unit_id":"u0031"},{"end":1581,"start":1478,"text":"degrade a protection layer rather than causing direct loss; delayed or hidden consequences — loss of
","unit_id":"u0032"},{"end":1677,"start":1581,"text":"corrosion inhibitor has no effect today and a substantial effect in eighteen months; escalation
","unit_id":"u0033"},{"end":1688,"start":1677,"text":"potential.
","unit_id":"u0034"},{"end":1689,"start":1688,"text":"
","unit_id":"u0035"},{"end":1790,"start":1689,"text":"Down: redundancy that is available and capable; items that can be bypassed without loss of function;
","unit_id":"u0036"},{"end":1893,"start":1790,"text":"atmospheric, non-hydrocarbon, low-energy services; consequences limited to housekeeping or appearance.
","unit_id":"u0037"},{"end":1894,"start":1893,"text":"
","unit_id":"u0038"},{"end":1918,"start":1894,"text":"## Two recurring errors
","unit_id":"u0039"},{"end":1919,"start":1918,"text":"
","unit_id":"u0040"},{"end":2017,"start":1919,"text":"**Voted arrangements.** One detector head out of a 2oo3 group is a degradation, not a defeat. The
","unit_id":"u0041"},{"end":2117,"start":2017,"text":"arrangement still functions, so impact is moderate rather than extreme. It is time-limited, because
","unit_id":"u0042"},{"end":2180,"start":2117,"text":"the group has lost its margin and the next failure defeats it.
","unit_id":"u0043"},{"end":2181,"start":2180,"text":"
","unit_id":"u0044"},{"end":2284,"start":2181,"text":"**Redundancy is a claim, not a fact.** Check whether the redundant partner is healthy before crediting
","unit_id":"u0045"},{"end":2379,"start":2284,"text":"it. If findings exist against both legs of a redundant pair in the same batch, the pair is not
","unit_id":"u0046"},{"end":2439,"start":2379,"text":"redundant. Assessing each finding in isolation misses this.
","unit_id":"u0047"},{"end":2440,"start":2439,"text":"
","unit_id":"u0048"},{"end":2451,"start":2440,"text":"## Urgency
","unit_id":"u0049"},{"end":2452,"start":2451,"text":"
","unit_id":"u0050"},{"end":2546,"start":2452,"text":"Not an average of likelihood and impact, and not the maximum, though the maximum is closer. A
","unit_id":"u0051"},{"end":2643,"start":2546,"text":"low-likelihood, high-impact finding on an SCE still requires attention this week. A near-certain
","unit_id":"u0052"},{"end":2741,"start":2643,"text":"failure of something inconsequential can wait for the next shutdown. Urgency expresses how soon a
","unit_id":"u0053"},{"end":2757,"start":2741,"text":"human must act.
","unit_id":"u0054"},{"end":2758,"start":2757,"text":"
","unit_id":"u0055"},{"end":2774,"start":2758,"text":"- 9–10: today
","unit_id":"u0056"},{"end":2793,"start":2774,"text":"- 7–8: this week
","unit_id":"u0057"},{"end":2813,"start":2793,"text":"- 5–6: this month
","unit_id":"u0058"},{"end":2844,"start":2813,"text":"- 3–4: next planned shutdown
","unit_id":"u0059"},{"end":2861,"start":2844,"text":"- 1–2: backlog
","unit_id":"u0060"},{"end":2862,"start":2861,"text":"
","unit_id":"u0061"},{"end":2964,"start":2862,"text":"Two conditions override the derived value. Anything that leaves a protection layer impaired without a
","unit_id":"u0062"},{"end":3062,"start":2964,"text":"recorded deviation is immediate, because the installation is out of compliance from the point the
","unit_id":"u0063"},{"end":3159,"start":3062,"text":"impairment is known. The same applies to anything that reduces evacuation capacity below the POB
","unit_id":"u0064"},{"end":3166,"start":3159,"text":"count.
","unit_id":"u0065"},{"end":3167,"start":3166,"text":"
","unit_id":"u0066"},{"end":3186,"start":3167,"text":"## Registry scores
","unit_id":"u0067"},{"end":3187,"start":3186,"text":"
","unit_id":"u0068"},{"end":3289,"start":3187,"text":"`reliability_score` is 10 = highly reliable, 1 = frequent failures. It runs in the opposite direction
","unit_id":"u0069"},{"end":3390,"start":3289,"text":"to likelihood. New starters routinely invert it. `criticality_score` runs in the expected direction,
","unit_id":"u0070"},{"end":3410,"start":3390,"text":"10 = most critical.
","unit_id":"u0071"},{"end":3411,"start":3410,"text":"
","unit_id":"u0072"},{"end":3512,"start":3411,"text":"Neither is sufficient on its own. Criticality is a starting point for impact, reliability a starting
","unit_id":"u0073"},{"end":3607,"start":3512,"text":"point for likelihood; the finding text moves both. A reliable item with a crack in it is still
","unit_id":"u0074"},{"end":3616,"start":3607,"text":"cracked.
","unit_id":"u0075"},{"end":3617,"start":3616,"text":"
","unit_id":"u0076"},{"end":3640,"start":3617,"text":"## Output expectations

","unit_id":"u0080"},{"end":3934,"start":3836,"text":"assessment is uncertain, that should be stated rather than resolved by picking a mid-range score.
","unit_id":"u0081"},{"end":3935,"start":3934,"text":"
","unit_id":"u0082"},{"end":4004,"start":3935,"text":"Recurring causes of loss of confidence in a triage output, in order:
","unit_id":"u0083"},{"end":4005,"start":4004,"text":"
","unit_id":"u0084"},{"end":4067,"start":4005,"text":"1. Confidently incorrect scores on safety critical equipment.
","unit_id":"u0085"},{"end":4169,"start":4067,"text":"2. Summaries that omit a detail that changes the decision — a measurement, a repeat occurrence, the
